video_title: Cavs Training Camp | Evan Mobley Media Availability | 10.02.2026

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on the need for improved team rebounding and physicality
quotes.excerpt: I think we just have to up certain attributes and certain statistics like rebounding and physicality.
quotes.quote: I think everything just has to be upped. I don't think we have to necessarily change too much. We did a great job last season overall, but I think we just have to up certain attributes and certain statistics like rebounding and physicality. It was all there before, but I think we just have to up everything.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley says the Cavs do not need to change their identity but must up their intensity in key areas. He specifically identified rebounding and physicality as the two stats the team needs to improve this season.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley praises Peyton Watson's impact during training camp
quotes.excerpt: He's definitely his own leader in his own way as well. He's vocal.
quotes.quote: He's been great. He's definitely his own leader in his own way as well. He's vocal. He's learned a lot over at Denver, so he has some stuff to say as well throughout our drills and the stuff that we're doing. I mean, he's obviously athletic, so I see some crazy defensive plays so far, and I think his shot is great as well for us. So, I think he's going to be a great addition to our team.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley is impressed with Peyton Watson in training camp. Mobley highlighted Watson's vocal leadership and athleticism, calling him a great addition to the team.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on James Harden's personality and leadership
quotes.excerpt: He's a normal dude just like all of us. I feel that's a big factor.
quotes.quote: Like you said, a legend. It's crazy that I get to play with him and be around him every day and learn from him. It's surreal in a way. But as I get to know him every single day, he's a great guy, just a normal dude just like all of us. I feel that's a big factor that a lot of people hold people on pedestals, but he's just a normal guy just like all of us. I feel that gives everyone else confidence that he has a good personality, natural personality, and gets along with everyone. He's not trying to big-time anyone or anything like that.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley on playing with James Harden: It is surreal to be around a legend every day, but he is just a normal guy. Mobley says Harden has a great personality and is not trying to big time anyone.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley's focus on maintaining defensive dominance while improving offensively
quotes.excerpt: I'm definitely going to still maintain my defensive game for the most part.
quotes.quote: I'm definitely going to still maintain my defensive game for the most part. That's always going to be number one. That's the natural thing that comes to me. But offensively, I'm definitely going to focus on that as well. That's a big focus that I've been focusing on in the summer and working on. And I think once both meet together, I'm going to be one of the best players. So, I think that's what I really got to focus on right now is both sides, maintaining the defensive but also still working on the offensive side as well.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley says his goal is to maintain his defensive dominance while taking a leap on the offensive end. He believes that once both sides of his game meet together he will be one of the best players in the league.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley's goals for simplifying his offensive game
quotes.excerpt: I got to simplify my game just like how I was just talking about with Kevin Garnett.
quotes.quote: I think offensively, I got to simplify my game just like how I was just talking about with Kevin Garnett and Tim Duncan. They had a very simple package and they got to their spots and just elevated very simply. So, that's what I'm trying to do as well. And defensively, just probably being more physical in certain areas on the floor and just asserting my dominance.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley is looking to simplify his offensive game by studying Kevin Garnett and Tim Duncan. He wants to get to his spots and elevate simply while being more physical on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Evan Mobley
quotes.summary_phrase: Evan Mobley on the importance of team chemistry for winning championships
quotes.excerpt: The most together teams are the ones that are winning the championship recently.
quotes.quote: I think it's both, on-court and off-court. I feel the most together teams are the ones that are winning the championship recently. So, doing stuff like this, coming to Spain, doing different activities, and bringing the team together is really important. So, when we get in tough situations, we know how to operate with each other.
quotes.social_post: Evan Mobley emphasizes the importance of team chemistry for championship success. He says that doing activities together off the court is vital for knowing how to operate when the team gets into tough situations.
